conclusions: The named compiler caches total approximately 22.7 GB; the largest surveyed old Agave cache is approximately 10.48 GB.
The surveyed caches do not cover the estimated 90 to 103 GB additional pre-full-snapshot capacity target.
Cache deletion is not a lasting disk-capacity fix. No cache deletion is planned or authorized by this review.
A durable byte bound for retained native metadata remains designed and unimplemented.
